title: Certify the E8 root-flat chamber classification premise
body:
## Result

Replaces the inherited F6 E8 root-flat classification citation with a self-contained chamber proof and an independently checked finite certificate. Every real root-spanned hyperplane is conjugate under the eight certified simple reflections to exactly one of the eight fundamental flats, whose root-line counts distinguish them.

This answers Open next question 2 of `complex-general-normal-boundary` (PR1521). The standard chamber argument is credited; this is a trust-boundary reduction, not a new decoder floor or selected-kappa change. PR968's alphabet, ordered simple basis and census representative keys are source-pinned. Frozen sources remain unchanged.

## Evidence

Python 3.12.14 normal/optimized exact replay passed: 240 roots, all 240 sign-coherent expansions, 1,920 reflection images, eight rank-seven flat representatives, 64 rational chamber fixtures, zero-normal exclusion and seven semantic mutants. Independent producer regeneration and a Git-free read-only export passed. Source-before-AST, typed receipt corruption and output-refusal controls passed. Registered commands and precise scope are in the new package's VERIFY.json and VALIDATION.md.

The arbitrary-real completeness argument is written proof, not inferred from rational fixtures. The other F0–F5 census facts, field-extension and physical implementation obligations keep their existing scopes. Prepared by ywz65 with Codex assistance.
